title: Puzzle 3d Mesh Serving Fix
description: Fix /meshes/*.glb 404 in puzzle 3d play and sketchpad: wrong meshRoot path and missing middleware in sketchpad/5d play.
summary: Fixed puzzle 3d GLB loading: meshRoot pointed at removed compose/assets/compose/metabolism path. Added shared puzzle3dMeshesVitePlugin serving compose/fixtures/kit/dev/metabolism/representations at /meshes/* for sketchpad, puzzle 3d/5d play, and static builds.
